name: introspect
description: Returns the active actors, their classes and schemas. Each actor has its class and bus addresses, by actor ID. Each class has its handlers once, with inputSchemaUri for args, outputSchemaUri for successful result.data, and help. The schemas map contains the common request and response schemas, handler schemas and all referenced documents, by absolute document URI. Clients can resolve application schema references from this map. Clients must provide standard draft-04 meta-schema support. An actor is removed when it stops, and a class when it has no actors.
